Maeve (Finance): FYI invoice PF-3321 from QuotaForge looks inconsistent. 'Overage smoothing' line doesn't algebraically match CSV totals. Can someone take a quick look? :thinking:

Jules (Procurement): Tagging @Nina @Owen. Quick summary pls.

Nina (Billing): Attached CSV snippet they sent:
```
line_id,sku,units,unit_price,subtotal,credit_code,credit_amt
L01,transformer.tokens,118600000,0.00002,2372,,0
L02,commit_discount,100000000,-0.00001,-1000,,0
L03,overage_smoothing,18600000,0.000064,1190,CF-SMOOTH,1200
```
Subtotal lines sum doesn't match final due. L03 subtotal 1190 vs credit_amt 1200 and 18600000*0.000064=1190.4 -> rounding mismatch.

Owen (Platform): Their public ratecard shows only $0.00002/token. $2,364 reported on invoice implies other fees or different per-token rates.

Sam (Legal): Request sample calculation and machine-readable export. Add clause in renewal requiring vendor to include per-invoice sample calc and deterministic rounding.

Iris (BillingBot): Invoice PF-3321 flagged: anomaly_score=0.82. Recommend manual vendor clarification.

Jules (Procurement): I'll send a clarification email asking for: (1) exact per-SKU rates used, (2) CF-SMOOTH formula, (3) native CSV with per-line pre/post rounding, (4) reissued invoice if unreproducible. Will CC legal and billing.

Maeve (Finance): Thanks. If they push on price, consider capped overage or blended rate for the renewal. Jane (cc) will model numbers after Jules posts the draft.
